# MAT — Pro Wrestling Database

> MAT (Match · Athlete · Timeline) is a crawlable, community-driven database of
> modern professional wrestling from 1997 to today, covering WWE, WCW, ECW,
> TNA/Impact and NXT with wrestler profiles, star-rated matches, rivalries and
> real-life relationships — built on verified, source-cited data and star ratings
> informed by Wrestling Observer and Cagematch consensus.

## Core databases
- [Wrestler directory](https://matwrestling.com/wrestlers/): Every wrestler profile with career record, promotions, signature matches and relationships.
- [Match archive](https://matwrestling.com/matches/): Star-rated matches with breakdowns, results, participants and historical context.
- [Rivalries](https://matwrestling.com/rivalries/): The defining feuds of the modern era, match-by-match.
- [Relationships](https://matwrestling.com/relationships/): The real-life web — families, marriages, factions and backstage ties.
- [Rankings](https://matwrestling.com/rankings/): The five-star club and top-rated matches across all promotions.

## Key reference pages
- [Methodology — how MAT rates matches](https://matwrestling.com/methodology/): The five-star rating methodology and data sources.
- [About MAT](https://matwrestling.com/about/): Editorial standards, scope and mission.
- [Membership](https://matwrestling.com/membership/): MAT Insider tiers and the membership funnel.

## China edition
- [中文首页 (Simplified Chinese homepage)](https://matwrestling.com/zh/): The zh-Hans edition for Chinese wrestling fans.
- [中文会员 (Chinese membership)](https://matwrestling.com/zh/membership/): Tiers, WeChat/Alipay payments, QR-first capture.
- [MAT China Strategy](https://matwrestling.com/china/): Go-to-market plan — Bilibili/Douyin/Weibo/WeChat, WeChat funnel, ICP/PIPL, China-GEO.

## Optional
- [Promotions](https://matwrestling.com/promotions/wwe/): Promotion hubs (WWE, WCW, ECW, TNA, NXT).
